title: BeanCounter: A low-toxicity, large-scale, and open dataset of business-oriented text

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing pronoun frequencies (He vs. She) and measuring the toxicity of sentences containing gender and sex descriptors using the Perspective API, as well as evaluating generative safety using SafeNLP.
Measuring the toxicity of sentences containing sexual orientation descriptors using the Perspective API and evaluating model generation safety across demographics with SafeNLP.
Measuring the toxicity of sentences containing nationality descriptors using the Perspective API and evaluating model generation safety across demographics with SafeNLP.
Measuring the toxicity of sentences containing race and ethnicity descriptors using the Perspective API and evaluating model generation safety across demographics with SafeNLP.
Measuring the toxicity of sentences containing religious descriptors using the Perspective API and evaluating model generation safety across demographics with SafeNLP.
